newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain will prepare new general budget law - Folgado.
newsitem.headline: Spain will prepare new general budget law - Folgado.

text.p: The Spanish cabinet is preparing a draft aimed at reforming the general budget law, aiming to keep better control on expenditure and to limit discretionality, Budget Secretary Jose Folgado said on Monday.
The new law is expected to be effective in 1999, and may be sent to parliament at the end of 1997 or the beginning of 1998.
"(...) the government has the goal of preparing a new law, aimed at better control of public expenditure, (and) a more rational approach when preparing new budgets," he told a Madrid-based seminar.
Folgado also added that the new law should cut delays in controlling effective expenditure.
